summary.disposition_rationale: Passes portable in-process certification gates G01-G07, G10, and G12 (measured speedup up to ~2.4x). Fails production distributed-qualification gates G09 (replica rejoin recovery stuck in DIVERGED due to cluster journal absence) and G11 (lack of durable WAL / restart persistence). G08 documents non-atomic sequential publication failure.

supported_claims: In-process group certificate formation reduces repeated protocol overhead by up to 2.4x
Exact final state and evidence root equivalence with UoW reference baseline
Bitwise identical authority decisions under divergent replica clocks
Fail-closed containment of malformed members and diverged replicas
Software journal compatibility enables full replica rejoin catch-up via SelfHealingController
Two-phase publication provides in-process all-or-nothing rollback
unsupported_claims: Physical multi-process distributed atomic commit (requires physical persistent WAL)
Physical crash restart durability without persistent disk storage
Cryptographic authority vote authentication (currently SHA-256 ballots, not Ed25519 signatures)
